# Asset & licence ledger

**Rule for this project:** no third-party art, audio, or model files. Everything shipped in `assets/` and every sound is generated by code in this repository.

## Generated here

| What | How | Where | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| PBR textures (albedo / normal / ORM): snow, packed snow, forest floor, bark, wood (floor, pale, paint, dark), log wall, plaster, wallpaper, concrete, brick, rock, rusted metal, wool, knit, canvas, parka, tile, ice, water, grass, gravel, paper, skin, books | numpy noise / Voronoi / FBM bakers | `tools/gen_textures.py` → `assets/tex/*.jpg` | original, same licence as the repo |
| Cards (pine/leaf/grass/flower billboards, soft dot, flake, footprint, stain, scratch) | numpy | `assets/tex/*_card.png` etc. | original |
| All 3D models: lodge, boathouse, ice house, tunnels, canoe, piano, fireplace, props, trees, characters, hands | code (`src/world`, `src/chars`, `src/levels`) | — | original |
| Photographs, comics, drawings, maps, the flyer | canvas drawing code (`src/story/draw.js`, `src/world/*`) | — | original |
| All sound & music | WebAudio synthesis (`src/audio/*`) | — | original |
| Story, dialogue, documents | written for this game (`STORY.md`, `src/story/notes.js`) | — | original |

## Third-party

| What | Version | Licence | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| three.js | r170 (vendored in `vendor/three`, also from npm) | MIT | WebGL rendering |
| esbuild | 0.28 | MIT | production bundling (dev dependency) |
| playwright-core | 1.63 | Apache-2.0 | headless QA only (dev dependency) |
| Cormorant Garamond (`@fontsource`) | latin 400/600 | SIL OFL 1.1 | UI & subtitles |
| Special Elite (`@fontsource`) | latin 400 | SIL OFL 1.1 | typed documents |
| Caveat (`@fontsource`) | latin 500/600 | SIL OFL 1.1 | handwritten notes |
| IM Fell English (`@fontsource`) | latin 400 + italic | SIL OFL 1.1 | newspaper clipping |

Attempts to download CC0 texture/HDRI libraries (Poly Haven, ambientCG) were blocked by the build environment's network policy, so none were used — the procedural bakers replaced them.
